decks.name: LeetCode #131 - Palindrome Partitioning
decks.description: Partition string into all possible palindromic substrings using backtracking

cards.question: Palindrome Partitioning: Given a string s, partition s such that every substring of the partition is a palindrome. Return all possible palindrome partitioning of s.

solutions.name: Backtracking I
solutions.explanation: Use backtracking with two pointers to explore all partitioning possibilities. Use j as start of current substring and i as end position. At each step, make two choices: if substring from j to i is palindrome, add it to partition and recurse from next position, or extend i to consider longer substring. Base case when i equals string length and j equals i (all characters processed). Check palindrome with two-pointer helper function. Explores all valid partitions. O(n*2^n) time where n is string length.

solutions.name: Backtracking II
solutions.explanation: Use loop-based backtracking for cleaner structure. Start from index i, use loop to try all possible ending positions j. For each substring from i to j, check if palindrome. If yes, add to partition and recurse from j+1. Backtrack by removing last substring. Base case when index reaches string length, add current partition to result. More intuitive than two-pointer approach. Uses same palindrome checking helper. Same O(n*2^n) time complexity with cleaner implementation.

solutions.name: Backtracking (DP)
solutions.explanation: Optimize palindrome checking by precomputing all palindrome substrings using dynamic programming. Build 2D DP table where dp[i][j] indicates if substring from i to j is palindrome. Build table bottom-up by length: single characters always palindrome, check if endpoints match and inner substring is palindrome. After preprocessing, use backtracking with loop to partition string, checking palindrome in O(1) using DP table. Trade space for time optimization. O(n^2) preprocessing plus O(n*2^n) backtracking. Better when multiple queries on same string.

solutions.name: Recursion
solutions.explanation: Pure recursive approach without explicit backtracking array. Precompute palindrome DP table same as previous solution. Recursive function returns list of all valid partitions from given index. Base case when reaching end, return list containing empty list. For each palindrome substring starting at current index, recursively get all partitions from remaining string, then prepend current substring to each. Build result bottom-up by combining subproblems. More functional style without mutation. Same time complexity but different implementation pattern.
